summary: The urgent purchase for {place} reaches finance even after the governor relaxes bidding rules.
realLife: The Russian River proclamation made procurement exceptions available for necessary drought response and kept finance department approval as a condition before signing a contract using them.
gates: A proposed purchase cites the applicable exception and identifies the finance approval status.
inGame: needs: a proposed purchase cites the applicable exception and identifies the finance approval status.

turns.what: Send the approved file to the contracting officer.
Tell the requesting agency whose approval is outstanding.
